## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and observable change. Link any relevant issue.

## Validation

List checks actually run and results. State what remains unverified, including native
GUI behavior, performance or installation scenarios relevant to this change.

## Review context

Describe security/performance implications and new dependencies or borrowed material.
Identify applicable licenses/notices. Use synthetic media; exclude personal footage,
secrets and unredacted local paths. Update roadmap/validation evidence when status changes.
